title: The Garden That Drinks the Moon
story: In the Moonwell Garden, Vantablume the Midnight Bloom has opened her enormous velvet petals and is swallowing moonlight, leaving the village herb beds cold and dark. The garden keeper tells Mr 6 that the moonwell holds 480 vials of stored moonlight, and Vantablume drinks 35% of the whole store on the first night. Mr 6 sharpens his pencil instead of his sword — if he knows exactly how much light is left, he can pour the rest into the herb beds before dawn.
question: After Vantablume drinks 35% of the 480 vials, how many vials of moonlight are left in the well?
solution: Find what she drinks: 10% of 480 is 48, so 35% = 48*3 + 24 = 168 vials.
There are 312 vials of moonlight left.
praise: Finding 35% of 480 was exactly the right first move — the last step was subtracting it from the full store.
hint: Start with 10% of 480, then build up to 35%. Remember the question asks what is LEFT.
victory: Mr 6 tips the remaining 312 vials over the herb beds, and Vantablume — suddenly outshone by a glowing garden — folds up her petals and sulks into a very ordinary flowerpot.
imagePrompt: A giant velvet black flower with silver-rimmed petals looming over a moonlit garden well while a small knightly numeral 6 in a blue cape pours glowing vials onto sparkling herb beds.
